//: Xbro10 fork: the Discord 'Playing' card (src/discord_presence.cpp; option Discord status). Not game data: read once by the game, not by the JSON loader. application_id is the Discord application's id from discord.com/developers (empty = no card). The image names must match the Art Assets uploaded to that application. 'places' is keyed by dimension id; 'default' is the normal world, and 'default:<mod id>' wins while that mod is active (the Backrooms mod turns the normal world into Level 0).
